sentences.text: Dated this the 05th day of February, 2026 The wife of Convict No. 2809, who is now undergoing imprisonment at Central Prison, Thiruvananthapuram, for the offences Under Sections 376(2), 377 and 506 of the IPC, filed this W.P(Crl.) under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for releasing the convict on emergency leave for a period of ten days to enable him to participate in the first death anniversary of his mother on 08.02.2026.

2. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, the convict is the only son of the deceased and his presence is necessary for performing the ceremonies in connection with the first death anniversary.
3.

The learned Public Prosecutor upon instructions submitted that on earlier occasions, when his mother was laid up and when she died, the convict was released and he had complied with the terms and conditions of emergency leave when he was released on previous occasions.

Therefore, considering the entire facts, this W.P(Crl.) is disposed of with a direction to the 4th respondent to grant Convict No. 2809 emergency leave for a period of five days from 07.02.2026,
including the time required for the to and fro journey.

Sd/-
